key_points: Abbott announced a daily protein powder delivering 30g protein with recovery-supporting ingredients.
Abbott unveiled plans for a heart‑pressure monitoring app that could detect worsening heart failure weeks before symptoms.
Both initiatives expand Abbott’s nutrition and digital health portfolios, leveraging existing R&D and distribution.
No financial guidance or earnings impact disclosed; market reaction has been muted.
Overall view remains modestly positive with potential upside over the next weeks to months as product roll‑outs progress.
